i.norm: Verifies that calling withGetterVisibility() with the same visibility value already in use produces a Value equal to the original. When all visibilities are NONE, the field visibility is also NONE. Applying withGetterVisibility(NONE) to a value whose getter visibility is already NONE should return an equal (though possibly distinct) Value.
Build a Value with every accessor restricted to NONE visibility
Retrieve the field visibility (NONE) and apply it as the getter visibility
Since the getter was already NONE, the updated value should equal the original
